payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation systems for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: The proposed VNBPE algorithm is used for effective word segmentation in Vietnamese texts to alleviate the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
Back Translation and Mix-Source methods were adapted to improve the NMT systems, addressing data sparsity issues.
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) was modified for subword segmentation to help with translation in low-resourced languages.
